changelog:
• New Multi-Brand Phone UI Styles: Pixel and Nothing OS styles are now live with custom typography & dot-matrix indicators
• 'Match my phone' auto-detection in Setup and Settings > Appearance > App style

• Jam background sync coordinator with faster low-latency Wi-Fi push synchronization
